actions.action: Open Network Studio and review package, permission, role, transport and encryption guidance
actions.expected: Nothing connects automatically; native UDP is identified as unencrypted localhost-only qualification
One Host and distinct Clients start from the returned executable path with unique PID, role, bind/endpoint, log scope and Inspector identity

actions.action: Focus each player and use WASD or the Move gamepad action
actions.expected: Host movement stays authoritative; client input reaches the bounded coop.move contract and both bodies replicate

actions.action: Enable seed 2607 with 80 ms latency, 20 ms jitter, 5% loss, 3% reorder and 2% duplication
actions.expected: Prediction remains responsive and authoritative restore plus recorded transform/rotation/velocity state-delta replay converges; the timeline records corrected ticks

actions.action: Inspect ownership, interest, bandwidth, replication diff, packets and rollback for each peer
actions.expected: Logs filters bounded editor-observed events by instance; the editor Inspector opens only process identity/status detail, while the corresponding player Inspector toggle shows live network state and its bounded editorState log

actions.action: Stop one client, reconnect it, then perform a late join and scene handoff
actions.expected: Stale ownership/reliable/input/timer state is removed; scene and baseline apply before live deltas resume

actions.action: Revoke permission and repeat ordinary offline Play
actions.expected: Connection and native socket access are denied while offline physics, scripts, rendering and input remain unchanged

actions.action: Repeat at every supported viewport/scale in English, German and Chinese
actions.expected: Tabs, fields, instance cards, log/Inspector controls and diagnostic rows remain readable with no overlap, clipping or root overflow
